The closing step of the skill records the analysis as done, in the same batch as its findings

violations.message: Trade Study has not been carried out — no analysis is on record for this system
violations.fixHint: Carry out the Trade Study: work through the skill se-trade step by step. First step: name the open decision with its options and criteria, then record the chosen option as a CR with relation(label: decides) edges to what it decides. The closing step of the skill records the analysis as done, in the same batch as its findings

violations.message: Assumption Review has not been carried out — no analysis is on record for this system
violations.fixHint: Carry out the Assumption Review: work through the skill se-irr step by step. First step: list every unproven assumption the model rests on (unmeasured numbers, unverified external dependencies) in a record under docs/records/, then promote the load-bearing ones to CRs. The closing step of the skill records the analysis as done, in the same batch as its findings

violations.message: FMEA has not been carried out — no analysis is on record for this system
violations.fixHint: Carry out the FMEA: work through the skill se-fmea step by step. First step: for each FCHAIN name its failure modes and add each one as a REQ with role risk (severity, occurrence, detection) plus a mitigation REQ and its TEST. The closing step of the skill records the analysis as done, in the same batch as its findings

violations.message: Implementation Plan has not been carried out — no analysis is on record for this system

The closing step of the skill records the analysis as done, in the same batch as its findings

node.name: Todo-CLI
node.description: Todo-Liste für die Kommandozeile: eine Person am Terminal legt Aufgaben an, liest sie und markiert sie erledigt; der Speicher ist die Datei todos.json im Arbeitsverzeichnis.

node.name: Aufgabe anlegen
node.description: Die Person legt eine Aufgabe mit Text an. Leerer Text oder nur Leerzeichen wird abgelehnt: Fehlermeldung, Exit-Code 1.

node.name: Aufgaben anzeigen
node.description: Die Person sieht alle Aufgaben, offene und erledigte; erledigte tragen eine Marke. Bei leerer Liste gibt es eine Meldung.

node.name: Aufgabe erledigen
node.description: Die Person markiert eine Aufgabe per Nummer als erledigt. Unbekannte Nummer: Fehlermeldung, Exit-Code 1. Bereits erledigt: eine Meldung.
